services.service_name: Issuance of Business Permit and Licensing Clearance
steps: Submit completed unified application form and required documents at BPLO Counter 1.
Wait for tax assessment and computation of fees.
Pay business taxes and regulatory fees at the Municipal Treasurer Cashier Counter.
Claim the Mayor's Business Permit, Business Plate, and Official Receipt at BPLO Counter 3.

services.service_name: Issuance of Certificate of Real Property Tax Clearance
required_documents: Official Receipt of Real Property Tax Payment
steps: Present latest tax declaration or property account number at Treasurer Counter 2.
Verify tax payment status and updated account records.
Pay PHP 100.00 clearance fee at the Cashier.
Receive signed Real Property Tax Clearance certificate.
Submit diagnostic medical results (X-ray, stool test) at MHO Triage Desk.
Undergo physical examination and medical assessment by the Municipal Health Officer.
Pay PHP 150.00 health fee at the Treasurer Window.
Claim validated Municipal Health Certificate.

services.service_name: Issuance of Building Permit and Ancillary Permits
services.fees: Based on NBCP Schedule of Fees (approx. PHP 1,500 - PHP 10,000+)
required_documents: Certified True Copy of Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT)
Five (5) sets of signed & sealed Architectural/Engineering Plans
steps: Submit five (5) sets of signed engineering plans and ownership docs at OBO Receiving Counter.
Technical evaluation and site inspection by structural, electrical, and sanitary engineers.
Issuance of Order of Payment upon technical approval.
Pay NBCP building permit fees at Municipal Treasurer.
Claim approved Building Permit and Construction Logbook at OBO Releasing Desk.

services.service_name: Issuance of Civil Registry Certificates (Birth, Marriage, Death)
services.office: Office of the Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR)
required_documents: Authorization Letter & ID of document owner (if representative)
steps: Fill out Civil Registry document request form at MCR Counter 1.
Verification of record entry in local civil registry database.
Pay PHP 100.00 certification fee at Treasurer Window.
Receive official true copy or certified transcription of record.

services.service_name: Issuance of Senior Citizen ID and Purchase Booklet
required_documents: Proof of Age (Birth Certificate, Passport, or Voter's ID showing 60+ years)
Barangay Certification of Residency in Tanza
steps: Submit OSCA application form and proof of residency at OSCA Desk.
Verification of age and voter/resident registration.
Encoding of senior citizen profile into municipal database.
Claim OSCA Identification Card and Medicine/Groceries Discount Purchase Booklet.
